Bull.story: Management's 13–16% delivered: membership grows again from 2027, Medicare Advantage margins sit at the top of 2–4% and commercial reprices to target, Optum Health reaches 6–8%. Revenue grows 6% a year to ≈$601B at an 8.1% operating margin, the ten-year median. The RADV fight is won or settled small. FY2031 EPS × 17, below the 18–22× UNH earned before 2024.

Base.story: Margin normalizes to ≈7.2%, held below the median by PBM pass-through, arbitration awards and tighter MA coding rules priced into bids. Revenue grows 4.5% a year to ≈$559B. FY2031 EPS × 15, a managed-care multiple with a premium for Optum.

Bear.story: Regulation caps the margin near 5.8%: RADV extrapolation and coding rules cut MA revenue per member, a DOJ settlement or a forced PBM/provider separation strips integration profit, and a Democratic Congress legislates PBM economics. Revenue grows 3% a year to ≈$520B. FY2031 EPS × 12, the peer multiple.
